_doc: Historical figures: where each one's campaign and presidential documents are collected from. 'archelec' = the en_soutien_a value in Sciences Po's Archives électorales (Internet Archive collection archiveselectoralesducevipof). 'programmes' = hand-listed official programmes (programmes.json format) with provenance. Add only URLs actually seen to be public. 'surname' + 'own_publishers': a document counts as the person's own campaign material only when its publisher (Archelec 'editeur', segments split on ';') names the person or matches one of the person's own party patterns; otherwise it is stored in third_party_documents. 'aliases': other ways a campaign publisher names the person.

own_publishers: ^Union pour la d[ée]fense de la R[ée]publique

emmanuel-macron.note: Archelec stops at 2012; 2017 and 2022 programmes are in programmes.json / vie-publique.
